MemberSignature.Value: .method public hidebysig instance class Android.Net.Wifi.Aware.SubscribeConfig/Builder SetEgressDistanceMm(int32 egressDistanceMm) cil managed

Docs.param: Egress distance, in mm, to the publisher above which to trigger discovery.
Docs.summary: An egress distance is configured to detect when the device exits a defined range.
Docs.returns: The builder to facilitate chaining builder.setXXX(..).setXXX(..). This value cannot be null.

remarks.para: An egress distance is configured to detect when the device exits a defined range. A discovery result with range will be reported when the device moves out of the range of the egress distance (outer threshold) to a matching publisher (based on the other matching criteria in this configuration). This can be used in conjunction with setIngressDistanceMm(int) to specify a geofence.

When both ingress (inner threshold) and egress (outer threshold) distances are set for geofence, the ranging result will be reported when the device moves either into the range of the inner threshold or out of the range of the outer threshold.

For ranging to be used in discovery it must also be enabled on the publisher using PublishConfig.Builder.setRangingEnabled(boolean). However, ranging may not be available or enabled on the publisher or may be temporarily disabled on either subscriber or publisher - in such cases discovery will proceed without ranging.

When ranging is enabled and available on both publisher and subscriber and a service is discovered based on geofence constraints the DiscoverySessionCallback.onServiceDiscoveredWithinRange(PeerHandle,byte[],List,int) is called, otherwise the DiscoverySessionCallback.onServiceDiscovered(PeerHandle,byte[],List) is called.
The device must support Wi-Fi RTT for this feature to be used. Feature support is checked as described in android.net.wifi.rtt.

MemberSignature.Value: .method public hidebysig instance class Android.Net.Wifi.Aware.SubscribeConfig/Builder SetFrameworkOffloadedPairingEnabled(bool enabled) cil managed

Docs.param: If true, enable framework offloaded auto-pairing.
Docs.summary: Configure whether to enable framework offloaded auto-pairing for this subscribe session.
Docs.returns: the current Builder builder, enabling chaining of builder methods. This value cannot be null.

remarks.para: Configure whether to enable framework offloaded auto-pairing for this subscribe session.

If this is enabled, the wifi framework will attempt to perform Wi-Fi Aware pairing automatically before starting the NAN datapath. When pairing happens for the first time, user authorization may be required (such as entering a pincode or password on the system UI).

As a result, apps are highly recommended to increase their connection timeout to at least 30 seconds when starting a datapath with this field enabled. Additionally, if the app is using framework offloaded pairing, the framework will override the AwarePairingConfig with a framework managed configuration.

MemberSignature.Value: .method public hidebysig instance class Android.Net.Wifi.Aware.SubscribeConfig/Builder SetInstantCommunicationModeEnabled(bool enabled, int32 band) cil managed

Docs.param: true for enable instant communication mode, default is false.

When setting to ScanResult.WIFI_BAND_5_GHZ, device will try to enable instant communication mode on 5Ghz, but may fall back to 2.4Ghz due to regulatory requirements. Value is one of the following: ScanResult.WIFI_BAND_24_GHZ; ScanResult.WIFI_BAND_5_GHZ
Docs.summary: Configure whether to enable and use instant communication for this subscribe session.
Docs.returns: the current Builder builder, enabling chaining of builder methods. This value cannot be null.

remarks.para: Configure whether to enable and use instant communication for this subscribe session. Instant communication will speed up service discovery and any data-path set up as part of this session. Use Characteristics.isInstantCommunicationModeSupported() to check if the device supports this feature.
Note: due to increased power requirements of this mode - it will only remain enabled for 30 seconds from the time the discovery session is started.

MemberSignature.Value: .method public hidebysig instance class Android.Net.Wifi.Aware.SubscribeConfig/Builder SetServiceName(string serviceName) cil managed

Docs.param: The service name for the subscribe session. This value cannot be null.
Docs.summary: Specify the service name of the subscribe session.
Docs.returns: The builder to facilitate chaining builder.setXXX(..).setXXX(..).

remarks.para: Specify the service name of the subscribe session. The actual on-air value is a 6 byte hashed representation of this string.

The Service Name is a UTF-8 encoded string from 1 to 255 bytes in length. The only acceptable single-byte UTF-8 symbols for a Service Name are alphanumeric values (A-Z, a-z, 0-9), the hyphen ('-'), the period ('.') and the underscore ('_'). All valid multi-byte UTF-8 characters are acceptable in a Service Name.
Must be called - an empty ServiceName is not valid.

Docs.summary: Sets the time interval (in seconds) an active ( SubscribeConfig.Builder.setSubscribeType(int)) subscribe session will be alive - i.e. broadcasting a packet.

remarks.para: Sets the time interval (in seconds) an active ( SubscribeConfig.Builder.setSubscribeType(int)) subscribe session will be alive - i.e. broadcasting a packet. When the TTL is reached an event will be generated for DiscoverySessionCallback.onSessionTerminated().
Optional. 0 by default - indicating the session doesn't terminate on its own. Session will be terminated when DiscoverySession.close() is called.
